title: A paragraph with tab stops
concept: A paragraph's TabList of TabStop records defines the positions a Tab marker in the run snaps to; alignment and leader come off each stop.

annotations.note: The TabList lives in the paragraph's Properties. Each ListItem wraps one TabStop.
A LeftAlign stop at Position="144" (pt from the column's left edge): text after the first Tab starts here.
A RightAlign stop at Position="432" with Leader=".": the page number ends at the stop, and dot leaders tile across the gap.
Each Tab marker in the run snaps the following text to the next stop past the current pen position.
